name: @hypaware/claude
description: Anthropic Claude Code client adapter for HypAware. Receives Claude Code OTEL events and raw body files through a local telemetry listener, projects exchanges through the AI gateway capability, writes session-context records into plugin state, and ships the hypaware-query, hypaware-reference, and hypaware-privacy skills.

commands.name: claude-hook session-context
commands.summary: Internal Claude Code hook: appends session context to the state file

commands.name: claude-hook classify-cwd
commands.summary: Internal Claude Code hook: prompt to classify an unclassified folder on an enrolled machine

datasets.name: claude_telemetry_events
datasets.summary: Claude Code behavioral telemetry: one row per event (tool decisions, permission mode changes, hook and MCP health, cost and activity metrics)

picker.name: claude
picker.label: Claude Code
picker.summary: Records your Claude Code conversations (CLI and SDK, including OpenClaw's claude-cli backend). Setup attaches Claude Code, starts its local telemetry listener, and adds query skills.

init_presets.name: claude-and-otel-local
init_presets.summary: Capture Claude Code + OTLP locally, export to Parquet under HYP_HOME/exports

config_sections.summary: Claude adapter config: backfill policy { on_join, window_days, sweep_cron }, attach-on-join policy { on_join }, and telemetry listener address { listen_host, listen_port }.
